title: MemRefine: LLM-Guided Compression for Long-Term Agent Memory
title_zh: MemRefine：面向长期 Agent 记忆的 LLM 引导压缩
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to operate over long-term interactions, where information from past dialogues must be preserved and recalled to support future tasks. However, as interactions accumulate, the memory store grows without bound and fills with redundant entries that inflate storage cost and degrade retrieval by crowding out the most useful evidence. Furthermore, this is especially limiting on resource-constrained platforms with hard memory budgets, motivating us to formulate storage-budgeted memory management, the task of keeping an already constructed memory store within a fixed budget while preserving information useful for future interactions. To this end, we then propose MemRefine, an LLM-guided framework that, since surface similarity poorly reflects factual value, uses similarity only to propose candidate pairs and defers delete, merge, and preserve decisions to an LLM judge based on factual content, iterating until the budget is met. Across multiple memory frameworks and long-term conversation benchmarks, MemRefine consistently meets target budgets while preserving downstream performance and outperforming rule-based baselines under tight budgets.
abstract_zh: 随着 LLM agents 越来越多地参与长期交互，系统需要保存并检索历史对话信息以支持未来任务。然而，交互不断累积会使 memory store 无界增长，并产生大量冗余条目，不仅增加存储成本，还会因干扰检索而削弱有用证据的召回。该论文针对资源受限平台中的固定记忆预算问题，提出 storage-budgeted memory management：在给定预算内压缩已有记忆库，同时尽可能保留对未来交互有价值的信息。作者提出 MemRefine，一个 LLM 引导的记忆压缩框架。由于表层相似度并不能可靠反映事实价值，MemRefine 仅使用相似度生成候选记忆对，再由 LLM judge 基于事实内容决定删除、合并或保留，并迭代执行直到满足预算。实验表明，在多种 memory frameworks 和长期对话 benchmarks 上，MemRefine 能稳定达到目标预算，同时保持下游性能，并在严格预算下优于基于规则的 baselines。
key_points_zh: 提出 storage-budgeted memory management 问题：在固定存储预算内管理已构建的长期 memory store，同时保留未来任务所需信息。
MemRefine 将相似度用于召回候选冗余记忆对，但不直接依赖相似度做删除决策，以避免表层相似与事实价值不一致的问题。
框架引入 LLM judge，根据记忆条目的事实内容决定 delete、merge 或 preserve，并迭代压缩直到达到预算。
在多个 memory frameworks 和 long-term conversation benchmarks 上，MemRefine 能满足不同目标预算并保持下游任务表现。
在紧张存储预算场景下，MemRefine 相比 rule-based baselines 更能保留关键证据，适合资源受限的长期 Agent 系统。

llm_assessment.comment: A well-scoped Agent-memory compression method that directly targets bounded storage through LLM-judged merge, delete, and preserve operations.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项定位清晰的 Agent 记忆压缩工作，通过 LLM 判断的合并、删除和保留操作直接解决存储预算问题。
